about: The side quests (stage 3b): about 2 in every village. Written like quests.json, but a step can be {"text": ..., "goal": {...}} that the game checks by itself: beat N monsters of a kind, climb a lookout in a land, or open a hidden chest in a land. A reward can also give great_sword, armor, life and treasure (a land: shows a hidden chest there). 'choice_rewards' lets the words pick the reward with finish_quest_with:quest:choice. phase2/side_steps.py explains it all.

bram_great_sword.title: Bram's Challenge
steps: Forge a Great sword at Bram's anvil (2 Perfect strikes and no Miss!) and show it to Bram

mabel_letter.title: A Letter for Old Finn
steps: Take Mabel's letter to Old Finn in Lakeside
Go back to Mabel in Meadowbrook

hazel_pie.title: Granny Hazel's Berry Pie
steps: Bring Granny Hazel 3 food (search forests with SPACE for berries)

steps.text: Beat 2 Sea Serpents out on the lake (take a boat)

lily_boat.title: Lily's Toy Boat
steps: Ask Old Finn in Lakeside which way the toy boat drifted
Find Lily's toy boat on the shore of the Old Ruins
Bring the boat back to Lily in Lakeside

gus_lookout.title: The Top of the World

steps.text: Climb a lookout tower in Frost Peaks (SPACE on the tower)
Dig up the hidden chest it shows you in Frost Peaks (SPACE on the chest)

steps: Tell Gus the Mapmaker in Snowcap

juno_postcard.title: A Postcard for Pip
steps: Take Juno's postcard to Pip in Meadowbrook
Go back to Juno in Sandwell

bubbles_potion.title: Eldon's Bubbly Potion
steps: Bring Madame Bubbles 5 wood (for the fire) and 2 food (for the potion)

wren_frog.title: Where Is Sir Hops?
steps: Find the clue Sir Hops left on the swamp's lookout tower
Follow the clue: find Sir Hops in Home Meadow
